title: PADiff: Predictive and Adaptive Diffusion Policies for Ad Hoc Teamwork
abstract: arXiv:2511.07260v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ad hoc teamwork (AHT) requires agents to collaborate with previously unseen teammates, which is crucial for many real-world applications. The core challenge of AHT is to develop an ego agent that can predict and adapt to unknown teammates on the fly. Conventional RL-based approaches optimize a single expected return, which often causes policies to collapse into a single dominant behavior, thus failing to capture the multimodal cooperation patterns inherent in AHT. In this work, we introduce PADiff, a diffusion-based approach that captures agent's multimodal behaviors, unlocking its diverse cooperation modes with teammates. However, standard diffusion models lack the ability to predict and adapt in highly non-stationary AHT scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based policy that integrates critical predictive information about teammates into the denoising process. Extensive experiments across three

translated_title: PADiff：面向临时团队协作的预测性与自适应扩散策略
translated_abstract: 临时团队协作（AHT）要求智能体能够与之前未见过的队友进行协作，这对许多现实世界的应用至关重要。AHT的核心挑战在于开发一个能够实时预测并适应未知队友的自我智能体。传统的基于强化学习的方法优化单一期望回报，这往往导致策略坍缩为单一的主导行为，从而无法捕捉AHT中固有的多模态合作模式。在本工作中，我们提出了PADiff，这是一种基于扩散模型的方法，能够捕捉智能体的多模态行为，解锁其与队友的多样化合作模式。然而，标准扩散模型缺乏在高度非平稳的AHT场景中进行预测和适应的能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的策略，将关于队友的关键预测信息整合到去噪过程中。在三个（任务上）进行了大量实验……
tldr: PADiff提出了一种将队友预测信息融入扩散模型去噪过程的自适应策略，能够捕捉多模态合作行为，使智能体在临时团队协作中实时预测并适应未见过的队友。
en_tdlr: PADiff proposes a predictive and adaptive diffusion policy that integrates predictive information about teammates into the denoising process, capturing multimodal cooperation behaviors and enabling agents to predict and adapt to unseen teammates on the fly in ad hoc teamwork.
